_: The runtime tests in tests/cs. Each test is the entry of tests/cs/<Entry>.csproj. Read by tests/lub-test (C#) and web/scripts/verify-player.mjs.
_args: Launch arguments of the runtime tests: fixes the frame in which a readback arrives
_runtime: Tests whose pass or fail is the exit code. They run on every backend of the OS: sdlgpu and vulkan on Linux, metal on macOS, d3d12 on Windows
_visual: Tests whose picture is compared with a golden image (tests/golden)

special.TestReadbackCapture: run with --capture, with and without loading the capture
special.TestUiRender: run only by the web verify
special.TestGamepad: run only by the web verify, which can provide a pad
special.TestKeyMods: run only by the web verify, which can send keys with CapsLock mapped to Ctrl
special.TestSaveDir: run with the save location set to a temporary directory, so that it does not write to the user's data
special.TestXrCapture: needs an XR session, so it is run only by the web verify, which can inject a fake session
special.TestDrawStateReuse: checks how the backend reuses binds, so it runs on vulkan, metal, d3d12 and webgpu
special.TestBindingsDigest: the digest is compared between the tcs VM player and .NET execution
special.TestBlendValue: run on the tcs VM player and on .NET execution, and the digests are compared
special.TestUnboundStorage: writes to a storage texture from a fragment shader, so it is run only by the web verify. sdlgpu can only read graphics storage textures, and stops on an SDL assert for the slots not passed in dispatch. The vulkan backend does not put writable graphics storage textures into the pipeline layout, and in SPIR-V that binding overlaps a StructuredBuffer, so lavapipe crashes on draw. Not verified on metal and d3d12

_special: Tests that are not in runtime or visual, with how they are run. The web verify runs all of runtime, visual and special

webSkip.TestReadbackOnQuit: checks that a readback queued inside OnQuit arrives right there. The web backend cannot wait for GPU completion on the main thread of the browser, so readbacks do not arrive before the next frame

dotnetSkip.TestOpenApp: App.Use is available only on the tcs VM player
dotnetSkip.TestAppState: App.Use is available only on the tcs VM player
dotnetSkip.TestAppInput: App.Use is available only on the tcs VM player
dotnetSkip.TestAppXr: App.Use is available only on the tcs VM player
dotnetSkip.TestAppObserve: App.Use is available only on the tcs VM player
dotnetSkip.TestInspectSet: App.Use is available only on the tcs VM player
dotnetSkip.TestAppTimeline: App.Use is available only on the tcs VM player
dotnetSkip.TestAppPick: App.Use is available only on the tcs VM player
dotnetSkip.TestAppInputs: App.Inputs is collected only by the player that can read a .csproj, and returns null on .NET execution
dotnetSkip.TestPick: checks the Site of Gfx.Pick. Only the tcs VM player creates Site

_dotnetSkip: Runtime tests not run on .NET execution, with the reason
_ios: Tests run in the app on the iOS simulator: capture is compared with the Linux golden within a tolerance, exit is judged by the exit code the app writes
